logging: A [W] with a portrait window open logs as [P] only while a line is typing in it (face_frames).
A name card logs as the shot it rides (rides).
A prop insert without a hand isn't a face or a hand.
[M] and [2S] are logged apart from [PF], [CU] and [ECU].
A video tile counts as a face only when it fills ≥ half the frame (Gerg's tile; the half-frame beats in the avalanche).
conventions.holds: held drawings on 2s or longer; whole-pixel moves; no rotation or scaling of sprites (angles are drawn, flips of hourglasses are drawn states); windows open in 3 held steps.
conventions.grid: Every cut on the act's beat grid (act frame 0 = 12:31:00). Scenes 24-26A sit exactly on 3.1's printed clock; from sc 27 the recorded lines set the length and the grid is kept.
conventions.rail: RAIL text types on when it changes and persists across cuts until replaced; hidden on BLUEPRINT and full-screen cards. [V/K] items carry RECONSTRUCTED until upgraded.
conventions.posts: Posts are unvoiced pop-ups in source casing (hold ceil_beat(0.25 s + 0.05 s/char) + 1 beat), except the read-aloud ones (TASYA 27.33, ALYI 30.01) and the voiced memo (31.06).
conventions.switches: BASE is the show. Tagged switches only: [BLUEPRINT] flash-print on 24.03's last beat → 25.07; [GLYPH] 20 f in 26.05 (use 2 of 2); [EARLY-WEB16] 26.11 f6 → 26.13 (F1.2); [2-TONE FREEZE] on the six Blip cards (Mas never freezes). MAS'S VERSION is a stillness flag, not a switch.
